[EN] Keeping Runes
[ES] Conservando runas
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Abia will be glad to see you.
[ES] A Abia le dará gusto verte.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Gotta keep those routes open.
[ES] Hay que mantener esas rutas abiertas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Runekeeper Rune
[ES] Runa de guardián de runas
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill {@creature:45#1003#argonomorph runekeepers} in the western part of the {@Rgn:45002$$Tower Approach} and collect runes.
[ES] Mata {@creature:45#1003#argonomorph runekeepers} en la parte oeste del {@Rgn:45002$$Tower Approach} y recolecta runas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Abia at {@Rgn:45007$$Field Base Tenacity}.
[ES] Informa a Abia en {@Rgn:45007$$Field Base Tenacity}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
